title: MultiTotemsFoxi
description: A large collection of various totems with various players from servers where Old_Foxi_PLAY was
body:
## What is this texture pack with totems ?

The totem texture pack gives you the opportunity to change your totem for the better
In this texture pack are quite a few totems with different players , memes , and twitch streamers/youtubers/

## And much more!!! =D

## What the MineShield does Hello Kitty and Donate have to do with it ?

MineShield - is a popular private server for content makers ,that includes only CIS YouTubers and twitch streamers

Hello Kitty - is a pack with Hello Kitty , created for fun and for those who love this franchise 

Donate - Those who paid to get into this texture pack are , on average , viewers of the Old_Foxi_PLAY channel

## !Also!

### We strongly recommend using [RP Renames](https://modrinth.com/mod/rp-renames) because without it, the texture pack will be very difficult to use, and using this mod, all the names and textures of totems will be shown to you in the anvil so that it is convenient to change them.
